# Upstream KEV JSON Schema (vendored, do not edit)

`known_exploited_vulnerabilities_schema.json` is CISA's own JSON Schema for the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog (JSON Schema draft-07), copied byte for byte.

| item | value |
|---|---|
| source | https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cisagov/kev-data/main/known_exploited_vulnerabilities_schema.json (CISA's repository `cisagov/kev-data`, which describes itself as a mirror of the official cisa.gov files) |
| retrieved | 2026-10-14 |
| size | 3,623 bytes (LF line endings, six tab characters, ends with one newline) |
| SHA-256 | `0d5865c98694c5bfba2c78a26caf814f406b3fce8bfb81bef79e99c7f288b0e7` |
| licence | Creative Commons 0 1.0 (the repository's `LICENSE`, SHA-256 `8dfcf2d0cba33bede386eb470daf2ac08caf6540fc2516baab10dd546f90938a`). Use of the data does not authorize use of the CISA Logo or DHS Seal and is not an endorsement by CISA or DHS. |

## Why it is vendored

- The `kev/1` parser is checked against it: the four required top-level keys (`catalogVersion`, `dateReleased`, `count`, `vulnerabilities`), the eight required entry keys (`cveID`, `vendorProject`, `product`, `vulnerabilityName`, `dateAdded`, `shortDescription`, `requiredAction`, `dueDate`) and the `cveID` and `cwes` patterns.
- The live probe (slice K6) compares the live schema with this copy and reports drift. The file must therefore never be reformatted or corrected here; a new upstream version is vendored as a new copy with a new hash and a changed row above.
- `tests/test_kev_parse.py` pins the SHA-256 above.

## Known differences between this schema and the real catalog (measured 2026-10-14)

- The catalog carries a top-level `title` that the schema does not define; PatchTrace reports it as an unknown field and ignores it.
- `dateReleased` is described as `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ`, but the real file writes four fractional digits (`2026-10-13T19:10:43.6568Z`).
- Four entry fields are optional in the schema (`knownRansomwareCampaignUse`, `forensicTriage`, `notes`, `cwes`); every entry of the 2026.10.13 catalog carries all twelve.

PatchTrace's own generated contract schemas live one directory up (`docs/schemas/kev/*.json`, generated by `tools/generate_kev_schemas.py`).
